{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 2: Handle assay_batch correction: batch B values are in µg/L, need to convert to ng/mL
# Since 1 µg/L = 10 ng/mL, divide batch B values by 10
df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final'].copy()
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_corrected'] = df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] / 10

# Step 3: Do NOT remove rows based on biomarker_baseline == -999
# The question asks for the mean of biomarker_final across all patients in the trial
# The data dictionary says -999 in biomarker_baseline is a QC failure, but the biomarker_final value is still valid
# So we keep all patients after deduplication, even if their baseline is -999
# We will compute the mean on all deduplicated patients

# Compute mean of biomarker_final_corrected across all patients
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'].mean()

# Confirm population: number of patients after deduplication
num_patients = len(df_dedup)

# Print results
mean_biomarker_final, num_patients"}
